claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord + magic_item mechanics family
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: No `magic_item` kind exists in the UnitRecord union. types.ts defines only SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord. The v4 taxonomy lists `magic_item_root` as a source atom but it is not wired into the surface schema. A MagicItemRecord type and at least one mechanics family must be designed before any magic item can be encoded.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Weapon (Glaive, Greatsword, Longsword, Rapier, Scimitar, or Shortsword), Very Rare (Requires Attunement)

claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_while_holding mechanics family (or passive_aura)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Frost Brand grants Fire resistance unconditionally while the weapon is held/attuned. No existing mechanics family covers a passive always-on effect tied to item possession. The ClassFeatureActivationMechanics requires an activationCost; OnHitTriggerMechanics requires a weapon hit. Neither fits.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: while you hold the weapon, you have Resistance to Fire damage

claude_proposed_widenings.name: RestResetCadence: time_based
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The flame-extinguishing property recharges after 1 hour, not after a short or long rest. RestResetCadence is a closed union covering short_or_long_rest | long_rest | short_rest | partial_short_full_long. A time_based variant (e.g., { kind: 'time_based'; hours: number }) is required.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Once used, this property can't be used again for 1 hour.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: extinguish_flames (or modify_environment)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The draw-action property extinguishes all nonmagical flames in a 30-foot radius. No v4 effect atom covers environmental flame manipulation. The closest existing atoms (damage, apply_condition, force_move) do not represent this.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you draw this weapon, you can extinguish all nonmagical flames within 30 feet of yourself.
